sourceTitle: History of Florence and of the Affairs of Italy From the Earliest Times to the Death of Lorenzo the Magnificent
description: "History of Florence and of the Affairs of Italy" by Niccolò Machiavelli is a historical account first published posthumously in 1532. Commissioned by the Medici family, this work chronicles Florence's turbulent past through Machiavelli's distinctive political lens.
